search_searxng_query: search a SearXNG instance for a query and return sorted SearchResult objects
search_searxng_with_language: search SearXNG with language and safesearch filters applied to results
search_searxng_with_time_range: search SearXNG filtering results by a specific time range
search_searxng_with_categories: search SearXNG within specific categories and limit result count
search_searxng_with_filter_list: search SearXNG and filter results by domain using a filter list
